cohort: 906 pregnancies with different patterns of growth: 655 AGA, 62 SGA, and 189 FGR.
finding: Unexpected SGA fetuses born vaginally had higher lactate levels and were more hypoxemic at birth than both AGA and FGR infants, but their neonatal outcomes were better than FGR infants, likely due to gestational age and birth weight similar to AGA infants.
mod_finding: Unexpected SGA fetuses born by vaginal delivery had more hyperlactacidemia and hypoxemia at birth than both AGA and FGR infants.
